stem_book: Match Column-I with Column-II. If 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π, then the number of solutions of: (A) sin²x − cos x = 1/4 (B) 4sin²x + 6cos²x = 10 (C) tan²x + cot²x = 2 (D) sin²θ = 1. Column-II: (p) 6 (q) 4 (r) 2 (s) 1
reason: (B) 4sin²x + 6cos²x = 4 + 2cos²x ≤ 6 < 10 has no solution and Column-II has no 0, so the match cannot be completed as printed.
work: (A) cos²x + cos x − 3/4 = 0 ⇒ cos x = 1/2 ⇒ π/3, 5π/3; (B) cos²x = 3 impossible; (C) (tan²x − 1)² = 0 ⇒ 4 values; (D) π/2, 3π/2
